caption: The drawing features three objects on a plain, beige background: a single earring at the upper left, a brooch or pendant in the middle, and a side profile view of the brooch at the lower right. The earring consists of a small yellow or gold screw-back clasp, followed by a short chain of round cream and gold beads, ending in a teardrop-shaped pink-purple gemstone with a gold mount at its top and a faint floral design inside. The central piece is an elongated oval-shaped brooch or pendant, made with a large, central, vertical pink-purple gemstone containing a delicate gold floral design inside. This gemstone is surrounded by two alternating rows of gems: an inner row of cream beads or pearls and an outer row of oval pink-purple gemstones, all set in yellow or gold-colored metal. The side profile view at the bottom right shows the vertical thickness and layered structure of the oval brooch, with the gems raised above a gold backing. The drawing is signed with "JOHN W. THORSON" in small print in the bottom left corner.
title: Brooch and Earrings
